title: UL-16 — Challenge: Private DNS
scenario: Design a private DNS layout with two records and document split-horizon behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Private hosted zone linked to VPC.
Split-horizon or separate private name documented vs any public DNS.
At least two private records (A and CNAME or two A).
Resolver behavior explained in notes (VPC DNS).
No public hosted zone for same name.
VPC association removed automatically on zone delete.
Query from EC2 optional; describe records sufficient.
No PHZ left with lab name.
stopChargesPanel: Delete every record you added (DELETE change batch), then the private hosted zone, then the VPC only if you created it for ul-16.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Uses: $ZoneId, $VpcId (the IDs you set while building; unset ones are skipped)
# Lost an ID? aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-16
# Set $VpcId only if you created a VPC for this lab. Never delete the default VPC.
if ($ZoneId) { $Rrs = aws route53 list-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id $ZoneId --query "ResourceRecordSets[?Type != 'SOA' && Type != 'NS']" --output json | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json }

if ($ZoneId -and $Rrs) { $Changes = @($Rrs | ForEach-Object { @{ Action = 'DELETE'; ResourceRecordSet = $_ } }); @{ Changes = $Changes } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Encoding Ascii ul16-records-delete.json; $ChangeId = aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id $ZoneId --change-batch file://ul16-records-delete.json --query ChangeInfo.Id --output text; aws route53 wait resource-record-sets-changed --id $ChangeId }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-16 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws ec2 describe-vpcs --vpc-ids $VpcId returns InvalidVpcID.NotFound (only if you created the VPC)
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-16 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-16. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-16) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
